exposure: early-onset ICP (diagnosed before 24th week of gestation)
cohort: The study included 742 singleton pregnancies delivered at the Shanghai Public Health Clinical Center between January 2015 and December 2023.
finding: Early-onset intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy was found to be an independent risk factor for the development of gestational diabetes mellitus.
mod_finding: Patients with both GDM and ICP had significantly higher rates of cesarean section compared to those with GDM alone.
